Resolves #19896

The showcase-dwell test now asserts the dwell, not an approach step, and leaves quarantine. It polled only kind and target, so it could match step 22 of the 24-step approach (a fallback tab-into) and then read step 23's edge-left paint: 110 px of a 220 px zone. Each dwell now waits on the driver's own gate, `drop-indicators`' `activeCandidate.preview.previewId === preview:audit:<target>:<kind>`, together with the painted kind. The assertion uses that same sample: kind and rect from one node in one `evaluate`, no second read. Test-only.

Evidence: L2 (the diagnosis replays every logged write of 72 hosted probe samples from the code and geometry) → L3 required (AC-2: every attempt green across ≥ 5 hosted runs). Residual: AC-2, Residual-Owner: this PR (re-runs before review).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `WorkstationFiveBeatNL.spec.mjs`: `awaitDwell(target, kind)` polls `readDwell()` until the gate and the painted kind agree, and returns that sample to `assertPreviewZoneAlignment` |
| AC-2 | The `BRAIN_QUARANTINES` entry is removed; hosted runs of this PR counted once green, recorded in a PR comment |

## Deltas from ticket
The painted kind is part of the wait, not a separate assert afterwards. The paint trails the worker gate by a few ms, so a gate-only poll could still catch step 23's edge-left paint. A kind that stays wrong for the whole dwell still fails at the 15 s timeout with the sample in the message.

## Test Evidence
Outside CI: `E2eCiSelection.spec.mjs` 23/23; Playwright `--list` registers the test under its unchanged title; the kind extraction checked against 720 class combinations the renderer can emit. The e2e itself runs only hosted (Brain runtime, multi-window).
